title: Engram card boundary lookup resolves Object.prototype keys (ENGRAM_CODE_BOUNDARIES indexed by a wire code)
outcome: The card's code-to-boundary lookup in ui/src/message-cards.tsx matches only its own entries (Object.hasOwn, a Map, or Object.create(null)). A refusal code such as 'constructor' or 'toString' falls back to 'Original failure details unavailable', not a function's source text. A vitest covers it.
acceptance: Engram card boundary lookup resolves Object.prototype keys (ENGRAM_CODE_BOUNDARIES indexed by a wire code) is done
